spec.name: Furniture Haunted Rag Doll
spec.description: A small seated Halloween rag doll with a cream stitched face, mismatched button eyes, orange yarn hair and a patched purple dress. Connected, floor-resting geometry fits within one block; front faces negative Z. All decoration is painted directly onto distinct cube-net UVs.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: small seated creepy rag doll with a cream cloth face, mismatched dark button eyes, stitched smile, orange yarn hair and patched purple dress; stylized Halloween prop, no gore. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
